sentence: This project uses quantitative MRI methods to study damage in the lower spinal cord in primary progressive multiple sclerosis.
This project studies how circulating tumor cells change their gene expression when they interact with extracellular matrix and stromal cells.
This project studies the mechanisms that underlie digestive diseases.
This project builds a tool that uses synthetic biology and machine learning to find the rules for how cells assemble into tissues.
This project compares single and multiple arterial grafting to see how each affects cardiac function and clinical outcomes after coronary artery bypass grafting surgery.
This project uses proteomics to find protein changes in blood and cerebrospinal fluid that come before the earliest signs of frontotemporal lobar degeneration.
This project builds a system that detects gamma and positron signals to image the human brain in finer detail.
This project studies the biology of arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, a heart muscle disorder caused by multiple genetic mutations.
This project tests whether methylated circulating tumor DNA markers in plasma can detect colorectal cancer relapse and predict therapy response.
This project studies whether real-world driver behavior, sleep and mobility can flag early signs of Alzheimer's disease.
This project engineers exosomes to deliver interleukin-12 mRNA for lung cancer immunotherapy and studies how cardiac fibrosis speeds lung cancer progression.
This project studies molecular machines, the enzymes, motors, switches, and pumps that power cell function.
This project studies how injury changes signals around suture stem cells during calvarial bone regeneration.
This project uses single neuron transcriptomics and mouse genetics to find and control the neuron circuits that let the brain communicate with the gut.
This project studies whether physical activity across the adult life course helps cognitive resilience to Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project tests whether a cell-surface protein on translocation renal cell carcinoma cells can be targeted as a treatment.
This project studies how endothelial cells from the adventitia affect atherosclerotic calcification in blood vessels.
This project studies gene regulatory networks that control how microglia are produced during embryogenesis.
